source.custodian: Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), Bangladesh
source.assessment: Official Magura district and RS survey discovery succeeded, but the bounded anonymous hierarchy stopped at an empty upazila response. No safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was available for retention.

attempts: See city-5562-magura.json parcelDiscovery.attemptedRoutes; all English/Bangla discovery queries and executed HTTP outcomes are recorded there.
scopeLimits: No exact-point parcel request was issued because the public hierarchy returned no Magura upazila/map unit from the bounded RS route.
The administrative district boundary response is not parcel evidence and was not retained as GeoJSON sample data.
An empty response, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI would not prove citywide absence; this packet makes no such claim.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe landholder fields, or TLS exception was used.
uncertainty: The public viewer may expose only currently digitized or currently indexed Magura survey units.
The discovered RS survey is marked চলমান (ongoing), and the empty downstream response may indicate incomplete public coverage.
Runtime integration remains held pending independent serial qualification of a real public parcel adapter.
